problem_description: Compute the average total energy per nanoparticle for a system of 100 nanoparticles (in 2D with number density 0.104) modelled using the body atom style (unit = lj) with nparticle bodies, where each particle is represented as a rigid collection of it's constitutents points forming polygonal shape. All particles were assigned initial velocities corresponding to a reduced temperature of 1.44 using random velocity distribution. Inter-particle interactions were modeled using the body/nparticle pair potential with a cutoff distance of 5.0 (in reduced LJ units), and interaction paramters with ϵ=1.0. and σ=1.0. The system should evolve in the nve/body integrator. A two-dimentional constraint (enforce2d) should applied to restrict particles motion in the xy-plane. The simulation should be carried out for a total of 1,00,000 timesteps.
